packageRules.description: cyclonedx-core-java 13.2.0 and newer are incompatible with cyclonedx-maven-plugin 2.9.3: 13.2.0 dropped commons-io and 13.4.0 dropped packageurl-java, both still required by the plugin, so the makeAggregateBom goal fails to load with a Guice ProvisionException. 13.1.0 is the newest version that works.
